title: Loudness
description: measure of the subjective hearing sensation on a scale extending from soft to loud; a progressive mono-frequency (single-frequency) wave of frequency 1 kHz and sound pressure level 40 dB, directed head-on to hearers is assigned the loudness 1 sone, and a tone which is identified by the listeners as being n-times as loud as that identified by 1 sone is assigned the loudness n sone
